summary: Nippon Ichi's Rhapsody-linked tactical RPG, best represented today by La Pucelle: Ragnarok on PC and Switch.

entries.title: La Pucelle: Tactics

emulation.notes: Use PC for the main run.

primary.why: La Pucelle: Ragnarok is the enhanced PSP version later brought to Windows and Switch through NIS Classics Volume 3; Windows is the cleanest capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play La Pucelle: Ragnarok on PC; use PS2 only for the original localized release comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ragnarok is an enhanced rerelease, not a full remake.
